_comment: The gather->post chain runs ONCE a day, kicked off at 17:00 America/Los_Angeles
so the 5pm digest previews tomorrow with freshly-gathered data.
Vercel Cron is UTC-only, and 17:00 PT is 00:00 UTC under PDT / 01:00 UTC under PST,
so each stage fires at BOTH hours and src/cron/window.ts lets only the one that is
actually 17:00 local proceed (the other returns immediately without working).
Local timeline: :00 ingest (core + extra in parallel) -> :06 dedup + luma backfill
The digest cron stays frequent because it also serves the Sunday 18:00 weekly; the
daily post is held until minute >= 28 (DAILY_POST_AFTER_MINUTE) so the chain lands.
